label: Gross annual income needed to afford an average new car
source: Average new car price in the UAE, AED 137,788 (YallaMotor UAE car price guide 2026). Loan terms from Emirates NBD Fixed Rate Auto Loan: 20% minimum down payment, maximum 60-month tenure, 5.06% p.a. reducing rate.
note: Assumes a AED 137,788 car bought with a 20% down payment and the balance financed over 5 years at 5.06% p.a. reducing, giving a monthly payment of about AED 2,083, and that the payment should not exceed 15% of gross income. A DERIVED figure resting on those stated assumptions, not a measured statistic. Dubai-wide: a car costs the same in every community, so this does not vary by area. The UAE average is pulled upward by luxury models; economy cars start near AED 48,000.
method: car price x (1 - down payment), amortised over the loan term, divided by the income share
